test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An object is placed on the principal axis of a convex lens of focal length 15 cm, at a distance of 40 cm. The magnification. produced by the lens is _____ and the image is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**less than 1, inverted.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **magnification** produced by the **convex lens** is given by the formula: **m = v/u**, where v is the image distance, u is the object distance, and m is the magnification.
 
• Since the object is placed **beyond the focal length** of the lens, the image formed will be** real, inverted, and smaller **in size than the object.
 
• Using the lens formula,** 1/f = 1/v - 1/u,** we can find the image distance as v = uf/(u-f) = (40 cm)(15 cm)/(40 cm - 15 cm) **= 24 cm**.
 
• Therefore, the magnification is m = v/u = 24/(-40) =** -0.6, which is less than 1**, indicating that the image is **smaller than the object.**
 
• The **negative sign** of the magnification indicates that the image is** inverted**, which is also consistent with the fact that the object is placed** beyond the focal point** of the convex lens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **convex lens** is a converging lens that is **thicker at the cente**r than at the edges.

 
 
• It can form** real or virtual** images, depending on the position of the object relative to the lens.
 
 
 
• The** focal length **of a lens is the distance between the lens and its focal point, where **parallel rays of light converge** after passing through the lens.
 
• **Magnification** is the ratio of the size of the** image **to the size of the **object**.
 
 
• It can be** positive or negative**, depending on whether the image is upright or inverted.
